correctness.rationale: Build the 18-vertex (9 point +9 nonvertical affine-line) Pappus incidence graph over F3, 27 edges; confirm BFS distance formulas (same-part coordinate distinction 2 vs 4, incident/not point-line 1 vs 3). The edge-pair discrimination family has 198 distinct nonempty masks from 351 pairs. Exhaustively assess all 2^18 landmark subsets by edge-distance signatures and masks independently: exactly 254100 resolving, coefficients 540,5976,17106,31392,43704,48620,43758,31824,18564,8568,3060,816,153,18,1 in degrees 4..18; none smaller. Four-subset finite equivalence to geometric two-column/two-slope and mixed affine incidence conditions yields 27+27+486 bases; 216 explicit affine-collineation/point-line dual automorphisms partition them into five orbits 54,54,108,108,216. This is a genuinely exhaustive FINITE proof, not extrapolation.
